properties.value: Transitive dependency (via elliptic@6.5.4) inside the hardhat/ethers toolchain; ships SHA-1 and SHA-2 implementations. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The signing curve of every Ethereum transaction and every Hardhat test signer in this repo. The on-chain verification side (ecrecover in the Solidity contracts) is reported separately as findings; this object records the npm/lockfile side. Changeable here only as far as the Ethereum protocol allows — secp256k1 is fixed by the chain, not by this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile declaration of the evp_bytestokey npm package (^1.0.0/^1.0.3), a transitive dependency of browserify-aes and browserify-cipher — the crypto-browserify polyfill chain the Hardhat/ethers toolchain installs. The MD5-based single-round EVP_BytesToKey KDF ships in the dependency tree; no first-party call site found in contracts/, scripts/ or test/. Changeable here only by pruning toolchain dependencies.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile declarations of bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 — the OpenBSD bcrypt_pbkdf (bcrypt/Blowfish-based PBKDF, itself depending on tweetnacl) — pulled in via sshpk/http-signature as a dev+peer dependency. Used for encrypted SSH-key passphrase derivation inside that chain; no first-party call site. Real bcrypt-family KDF in the shipped tree; the object label 'bcrypt password hashing' is broader than the sites, which are bcrypt-pbkdf specifically.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile declarations of create-ecdh@^4.0.0 — crypto-browserify's ECDH polyfill (elliptic-curve based), a transitive dependency of the Hardhat/ethers toolchain. Classical ECDH is available in the shipped dependency tree; no first-party call site found in contracts/, scripts/ or test/.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 (dep_scan finding) provides Ed25519 signing to the shipped tree; it sits nested under bcrypt-pbkdf in the sshpk/http-signature chain (dev+peer). No first-party call site found — Hardhat/ethers does their own crypto; this ships only as toolchain ballast.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is Ethereum's native hash (tx hashes, address derivation, signature digests). Live uses in this repo: test/FlashLoan.js:27 (RLP contract-address pre-computation) and test/MyReplaylist.js:27 (permit digest). The MyReplaylist chain is a full ECDSA-secp256k1 signing flow: ethers.utils.keccak256 digest at line 27 → daiDeployer.signMessage(...) at line 25 (Hardhat/ethers Signer wrapper → @ethersproject/signing-key → elliptic secp256k1 ECDSA) → v/r/s consumed by StakingVault.withdrawWithPer

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 is used by the Ethereum toolchain for BIP39 mnemonic→seed wallet derivation. No application call site in this repo, but the shipped library makes PBKDF2 (HMAC-SHA256, default parameters) available to any code in the toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
